Your End-to-End Warehouse Solutions Provider

Tour an Exotec Warehouse

Exotec is an end-to-end warehouse automation integrator and technology manufacturer (OEM), delivering solutions that combine robotics, software, and operational expertise. We design, integrate, and deploy scalable warehouse solutions that support complex operations across industries.

Over 75 brands across the globe rely on Exotec solutions for their warehouse operations.

The Modern Approach to Warehouse Operations

Every warehouse faces the same challenges every day, balancing cost, speed, and accuracy to deliver on your customer promise. When constraints tighten, the gaps between systems become exposed. At Exotec, we operate under a different philosophy: one that is more flexible, reliable, and offers faster time to value than legacy automation solutions.

Flexible

Our modular, plug-and-play solutions scale and reconfigure on demand without disrupting operations.

Reliable

We define outcomes upfront and uphold rigorous standards. Results are transparent and measurable over time.

Faster Time to Value

Move from decision to impact—fast. Modular, connected systems speed up installation and results.

Designed to Scale With Your Business

End-To-End Solutions Rooted in Elegant Engineering

Our all-in-one AS/RS is designed to remove unnecessary equipment and streamline the flow of your warehouse. Since we build and deploy our own products, we can ensure the hardware delivers the best output.

Learn More

The Sole Provider for Your Entire Ecosystem

As a full-service integrator, we work as part of your team, deeply understanding your challenges and working together to achieve the same goals.

Understand Our Approach

The Brain Behind Your Operations

All hardware within your solution is orchestrated by one software layer: our WES, Deepsky. This gives you complete control over the flow of goods in the warehouse without having to customize individual software modules for each subsystem. Its flexibility to adapt to any new system allows you to see faster time to value from your complete solution.

Learn More

No Unnecessary Equipment. No Bottlenecks. All Performance.

We take an industry-based approach, designing holistic solutions meticulously tailored for the unique needs of different industries.

Ready to Transform Your Operations?

With more than a century of combined experience upgrading warehouse automation around the world, our team has the expertise to support projects of any scale—delivering rapid, tangible value from day one after go-live.
